title: Jazz Music and Its Origins
text: Jazz is a music genre that originated in African American communities of New Orleans in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It developed from blues and ragtime and is characterized by swing and blue notes, call and response, polyrhythms, and improvisation. Early jazz musicians include Louis Armstrong (trumpet), Duke Ellington (piano and bandleader), Charlie Parker (alto saxophone), Dizzy Gillespie (trumpet), and Miles Davis (trumpet). The 1920s are often called the Jazz Age. Jazz has given rise to numerous subgenres including swing, bebop, cool jazz, hard bop, modal jazz, jazz fusion, and smooth jazz. Jazz has had a profound influence on other genres, including rock, soul, and hip-hop.
